summary: Enhance your skills with our Cloud Computing and Infrastructure Management Course. Learn essential concepts and tools to excel in today's tech-driven world.
lede: Cloud computing management covers assessing, securing, monitoring, and governing cloud infrastructure. It is for cloud administrators, infrastructure and systems engineers, operations managers, and solution architects who need to assess workloads, design access and networks, review infrastructure changes, monitor service health, respond to incidents, and manage cloud costs.
audienceIntro: This cloud infrastructure management course is designed for professionals who support, operate, secure, or govern cloud-based technology services and need a practical route from foundational concepts to controlled execution.
prerequisites: No programming background is required. You should have basic familiarity with servers, networks, operating systems, or IT service operations. You will review Terraform configurations and cloud console workflows, but the course does not require production deployment or software development. Bring a laptop if you want to follow optional browser-based demonstrations. TrainingCred can provide structured lab files and sample datasets for the facilitated exercises.
